summary: Jens 'Jay' Yambert, 60, was last seen Aug 27 on the Keyhole Route; body found Aug 31 west of Keplinger's Couloir below the Homestretch after an approximately 200-foot tumbling fall; technical lower and helicopter recovery completed Sept 2
notes: Investigation indicated a ~200-foot tumbling fall with apparent instantaneous death; search began Aug 28 after family reported him overdue MERGE run469: NPS Aug-30-2018 Yambert-search release appended (carries the separate Emma Long rescue narrative). NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry; compendium dates the case to 2018-08-26 (search start), existing date 2018-08-27 (last seen) kept.
